title: Wake-up and continuation
summary: Active and stale recipients whose hook route is absent use stopped-session resume through waiting wake mode. Active calls, version floors and operator wake authority still govern eligibility. Detached captures refresh during hook-silent commands. An open tool call holds automatic wakes until it returns, unless a verified native exit or a park stamped after it started retires it, so a parked codex session whose call never recorded completion is still woken. Native death with matching process start time releases its held wake budget and Fleet label; a later delivered wake also supersedes the hold. Fleet silence names its observation time. Manual wake preserves unrelated unread envelopes; grace limits wake blocking, not retention. A relay worker whose surface cannot hold a turn and stops with a live claim gets the same stopped-session wake automatically, bounded by the reinjection ceiling and cooldown, unless its item is armed in the merge queue (including an open re-land attempt), where the landing notice is the wake; a capped or refused wake is mailed to steering with its reason and recovery.
